Thanks for the PO — got it. Short answers up front, then options so you can pick what works best:

1) Billing/legal entity: we can issue under one of the following depending on your accounting needs:
   - Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — will include US EIN 12-3456789
   - Redwood Inference Europe Ltd (EU) — will include VAT GB999999999
   - Redwood Inference (Global) — limited use, may require additional tax docs

2) Delivery:
   - Email PDF: we send a PDF to invoices@fossilhealth.com and CC any internal addresses you specify. Quick and manual.
   - Portal / E-invoice: we can push a structured e-invoice (Peppol/Coupa/EDI) into your AP system. Better for automated matching.
   - SFTP/webhook: alternate automated delivery if you prefer file drops.

For the EU VAT flow, if you want us to bill the EU entity we will need the invoice recipient VAT number you expect on the invoice (we'll also store VAT evidence).

I've attached a sample PDF preview (sample_invoice_preview_RI-0001.pdf) so you can confirm layout and PO field placement. If you confirm: 1) which legal entity to bill, 2) exact invoice-to email or portal endpoint, and 3) whether we should embed the PO in the invoice header, we'll raise the invoice and include the PO number.

Happy to set up a 15-minute call if there are any compliance checks on your side.
